name: The Graveyards of Alterac
label: Quest
description: The Graveyards of Alterac: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The battle lines of Alterac Valley are ever shifting. Territories swing back and forth as we meet our opponents in deadly combat. And graveyards, friend, are where battles rage most fierce.
I want you to attack an Alliance held graveyard! Find a graveyard with an Alliance banner in its midst and pull it from the ground.
Do that and your task for me will be complete, but... If you hold the graveyard for a few minutes, then it will be ours and troops will come and relieve you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Attack a graveyard held by the Alliance!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend! With each graveyard under our control, the spirits of our enemies will wander more lost and aimless.
